description: Scoring rules and filter definitions for the ToolNest Decision Engine

categories.label: Category
categories.description: Filter tools by one or more categories

useCases.label: Use Cases
useCases.description: Select what you want to accomplish

platforms.label: Platform
platforms.disabledReason: Only 4 of 153 tools have platform data. Filter disabled until coverage improves.

hasFreePlan.label: Free Plan Available
hasFreePlan.description: Only show tools with a free plan or free trial
hasFreePlan.disabledReason: Only 1 of 153 tools has freePlan.available=true. Filter disabled until coverage improves.

hasCons.label: Show Known Drawbacks
hasCons.description: Display cons and skipIf warnings in results

scoring.description: Explainable scoring rules. Each rule contributes points and a human-readable reason.

rules.label: Use Case Match
rules.description: Tool's useCaseTags match your selected use cases
rules.evidence_state: VERIFIED_MATCH when tags exist and match, UNKNOWN when tags missing

rules.label: Category Match
rules.description: Tool is in one of your selected categories
rules.evidence_state: VERIFIED_MATCH when category matches, VERIFIED_MISMATCH when it doesn't

rules.label: Best For Match
rules.description: Tool's bestFor tags match your selected use cases
rules.evidence_state: VERIFIED_MATCH when bestFor exists and matches, UNKNOWN when missing

rules.label: Platform Match
rules.description: Tool is available on your selected platforms
rules.evidence_state: VERIFIED_MATCH when platforms match, UNKNOWN when platform data missing

evidence_confidence.description: Separate from fit score. Measures how much verified data supports this tool's profile.

strong.label: Strong evidence
strong.description: Multiple verified data points support this recommendation

moderate.label: Moderate evidence
moderate.description: Some verified data points, but gaps remain

limited.label: Limited evidence
limited.description: Few or no verified data points — recommendation based on category match only

disqualifiers.description: High-impact filters that reduce eligibility when evidence supports them. UNKNOWN data lowers confidence but does not disqualify.

rules.condition: User requires platform X, tool explicitly does not support it
User requires free plan, tool verified as paid-only
User has budget constraint, tool pricing exceeds it
